title: Chapter 7070: Comparable To The High Heaven?

Chapter 7070: Comparable To The High Heaven?

Chapter 7070: Comparable To The High Heaven?

“Obeyed the octopus when alive and still controlled by the octopus after death? What else should I call him but a puppet?” Li Qiye said.

“Ridiculous!” Demise and Slayer were furious.

“Enough!” Incinerator was even more direct and summoned a staff.

“Crackle!” As he pointed the staff, a bolt in the ocean obeyed and struck Li Qiye’s chest.

This bolt contained the essences and powers of the entire ocean, strong enough to reduce the nine major worlds into barren wastelands.

Thus, smoke came from Li Qiye’s chest with a scent of burnt flesh.

“A bit capable, but that’s all.” Li Qiye smiled, blocking the move from the ruler of the tribulations directly.

In this ocean, Incinerator could defeat celestial immortals with apex power, potentially even those who have let go. Alas, this didn’t work against Li Qiye.

“Reveal your true face.” Li Qiye smiled: “Let me see what kind of abomination you are.”

Listeners became surprised, the four celestial immortals included.

“He has no head, what face is there to look at?” An immortal said.

“Didn’t you say this was Incinerator?” Zhao Dachui spoke up.

“How do you know it’s him?” Li Qiye asked.

Zhao Dachui stared at the other two who should know the answer. After all, everyone was revived by Incinerator.

“Of course it’s him, he is our senior brother. His mastery over life is peerless, comparable to the high heaven.” Slayer uttered coldly.

“Comparable to the high heaven?” Li Qiye smirked.

“It’s because you don’t know how our senior brother had created a supreme heavenly kingdom with countless inhabitants...” Demise said.

“Heavenly?” Li Qiye dismissed this: “The high heaven didn’t give permission and killed everything, your senior brother included. The kingdom is nothing more than a grand cemetery.”

“...” The two found Li Qiye’s knowledge unbelievable.

This happened long ago and their alliance had always kept a low profile. They only revealed themselves for Heaven Pit.

Their senior brother was even older, forgotten by Heavenrealm. He was ambitious and great enough to create life just like the high heaven. Alas, he was punished with decapitation.

“I knew a thing or two, the rest was speculation.” Li Qiye smiled.

“What is this true face you speak of if he is Incinerator?” Dragongrasp asked.

“Only the body is Incinerator.” Li Qiye said.

“Who else can it be?” Demise said.

“Have you ever seen the dead capable of creating life? He wouldn’t have died in the first place if he had this ability. Someone is borrowing his life ability.” Li Qiye said.

“...” The two froze for a second.

Although this was not a true revival, they were living from the connection with the tribulation ocean. The life attached to them was real and purposely formed for them. This created a better revival than just making them walking corpses. After all, they remained sentient and had full power.
